title: An Interview with a Chef
text:
Today we talk with Tom, a chef in a small restaurant. He started cooking when he was twelve. He says that cooking makes him happy. He works every evening except Monday.

Tom also talks about his plans. He wants to open his own restaurant next year. He is saving money every month. He says his family will help him.

questions.text: What does Tom want to do next year?
What kind of person is Tom most likely to be?
Why does Tom save money every month?
options: He wants to buy a car
He wants to pay for his restaurant

vocabulary.definition: a professional cook who works in a restaurant
a place where people pay to eat meals
keeping money for use in the future instead of spending it

paragraph_translations: Hoy hablamos con Tom, un cocinero de un pequeño restaurante. Empezó a cocinar cuando tenía doce años. Dice que cocinar lo hace feliz. Trabaja todas las noches excepto los lunes.
Tom también habla de sus planes. Quiere abrir su propio restaurante el próximo año. Está ahorrando dinero cada mes. Dice que su familia le va a ayudar.
